I SHUT MY EYES INVOLUNTARILY AND ENDEAVOURED TO RECOLLECT WHAT WERE MY DUTIES WITH REGARD TO THIS DESTROYER. I CALLED ON HIM TO STAY. HE PAUSED, LOOKING ON ME WITH WONDER, AND AGAIN TURNING TOWARDS THE LIFELESS FORM OF HIS CREATOR, HE SEEMED TO FORGET MY PRESENCE, AND EVERY FEATURE AND GESTURE SEEMED INSTIGATED BY THE WILDEST RAGE OF SOME UNCONTROLLABLE PASSION. THAT IS ALSO MY VICTIM! HE EXCLAIMED. IN HIS MURDER MY CRIMES ARE CONSUMMATED; THE MISERABLE SERIES OF MY BEING IS WOUND TO ITS CLOSE! OH, FRANKENSTEIN! GENEROUS AND SELF-DEVOTED BEING! WHAT DOES IT AVAIL THAT I NOW ASK THEE TO PARDON ME? I, WHO IRRETRIEVABLY DESTROYED THEE BY DESTROYING ALL THOU LOVEDST. ALAS! HE IS COLD, HE CANNOT ANSWER ME.
